          Alert description

          La Política de seguridad de contenido (CSP) es una capa adicional de seguridad que ayuda a detectar y mitigar ciertos tipos de ataques, incluidos Cross Site Scripting (XSS) y ataques de inyección de datos. Estos ataques se utilizan para todo, desde el robo de datos hasta la desfiguración del sitio o la distribución de malware. CSP proporciona un conjunto de encabezados HTTP estándar que permiten a los propietarios de sitios web declarar fuentes de contenido aprobadas que los navegadores deberían poder cargar en esa página; los tipos cubiertos son JavaScript, CSS, marcos HTML, fuentes, imágenes y objetos incrustados como applets de Java, ActiveX, archivos de audio y video.

      .impact-item:hover .impact-icon {
        transform: scale(1.05);
        -webkit-transform: scale(1.05);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);

        max-width: 800px;
        margin: 0 auto 40px;
        opacity: 0.95;
        font-size: 17px;
        line-height: 1.6;

      .carousel-track {
        display: flex;
        gap: 24px;
        align-items: center;
        animation: slide 40s linear infinite;
        -webkit-animation: slide 40s linear infinite;
        width: fit-content;
        will-change: transform;
      }
      .logo-item {
        min-width: 200px;
        height: 130px;
        background: #ffffff;
        border: 1px solid #e8e8e8;
        border-radius: 16px;

      .logo-item:hover {

        box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(121, 13, 127, 0.1);
        border-color: #790d7f;
      }
      .logo-item img {
        max-width: 100%;
        max-height: 100%;
        object-fit: contain;
      }

      @keyframes slide {
        0% {
          transform: translateX(0);

        100% {
          transform: translateX(-50%);

      .country-grid {

      .modal {
        display: none;
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 1000;
        left: 0;
        top: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        overflow: auto;
        background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
        backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
        padding: 20px;
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
      }
      .modal[style*="display: flex"] {
        opacity: 1;
      }
      @keyframes slideDown {
        from {
          transform: translateY(-50px) scale(0.95);
          opacity: 0;
        }
        to {
          transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
          opacity: 1;
        }
      }
      .modal-content {
        position: relative;
        background: linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98) 0%,
          rgba(248, 250, 255, 0.98) 100%
        );
        margin: 3% auto;
        padding: 0;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 950px;
        border-radius: 30px;
        box-shadow: 0 25px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
        animation: slideDown 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
        overflow: hidden;
        border: none;
      }
      .modal-close {
        position: absolute;
        top: 25px;
        right: 25px;
        background: linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98) 0%,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) 100%
        );
        border: 2px solid rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.2);
        font-size: 32px;
        font-weight: 300;
        color: #667eea;
        cursor: pointer;
        z-index: 10;
        width: 55px;
        height: 55px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
        box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .modal-close:hover {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #790d7f 0%, #9b5de5 100%);
        color: white;
        transform: rotate(90deg) scale(1.15);
        box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(121, 13, 127, 0.6);
        border-color: transparent;
      }
      .modal-body {
        padding: 0;
        max-height: 85vh;
        overflow-y: auto;
      }
      .modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 8px;
      }
      .modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
        border-radius: 10px;
      }
      .modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
        border-radius: 10px;
      }
      .modal-image {
        width: 100%;
        height: 450px;
        object-fit: cover;
        display: block;
        border-radius: 30px 30px 0 0;
      }
      .modal-title {
        font-size: 44px;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: #333;
        margin: 45px 55px 25px;
        line-height: 1.2;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
        -webkit-background-clip: text;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        background-clip: text;
        letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      }
      .modal-description {
        padding: 0 55px 55px;
        font-size: 18px;
        line-height: 1.9;
        color: #444;
      }
      .modal-description h4 {
        font-size: 26px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #333;
        margin-top: 35px;
        margin-bottom: 18px;
        position: relative;
        padding-left: 20px;
      }
      .modal-description h4::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        width: 5px;
        height: 28px;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
        border-radius: 3px;
      }
      .modal-description p {
        margin-bottom: 20px;
        text-align: justify;
      }
      .modal-description ul {
        margin: 20px 0;
        padding-left: 30px;
      }
      .modal-description li {
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        line-height: 1.8;
        position: relative;
        padding-left: 10px;
      }
      .modal-description li::marker {
        color: #667eea;
        font-weight: 600;
      }
      .campos-empresa {
        animation: slideInDown 0.4s ease-out;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      @keyframes slideInDown {
        from {
          max-height: 0;
          opacity: 0;
        }
        to {
          max-height: 500px;
          opacity: 1;
        }
      }
      @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .modal-content {
          width: 95%;
          margin: 10% auto;

        .modal-image {
          height: 250px;
        }
        .modal-title {
          font-size: 28px;

          transform: translateY(0);
        }

      .modal-new {

        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 1000;
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
      }

      .modal-new.active {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        padding: 20px;
        opacity: 1;
      }

      .modal-backdrop {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
        backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      }

      .modal-container-new {
        position: relative;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 900px;
        max-height: 90vh;
        background: #ffffff;
        border-radius: 24px;

        box-shadow: 0 25px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
        animation: modalSlideIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);

        to {
          transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
          opacity: 1;
        }

      <section id="hero" class="hero">
        <div class="hero-overlay"></div>
        <div class="hero-content container">
          <h1 class="hero-title">UN PROPÓSITO QUE NACIÓ DE COLOMBIA</h1>
          <h2 class="hero-subtitle">HOY INSPIRA A TODA LATINOAMÉRICA</h2>
          <div class="hero-logos">
            <a href="https://colombiacomparte.com" class="hero-logo-item">
              <img src="img/LOGOS/Colombia Co N.png" alt="Colombia Comparte" />
            </a>
            <a href="https://ecuadorcomparte.com.co" class="hero-logo-item">
              <img src="img/LOGOS/Ecuador Co N.png" alt="Ecuador Comparte" />
            </a>
            <a href="#hero" class="hero-logo-item hero-logo-main">
              <img
                src="img/LOGOS/Latinoamérica Co N.png"
                alt="Latinoamérica Comparte"
              />
            </a>
            <a href="https://chilecomparte.com.co" class="hero-logo-item">
              <img src="img/LOGOS/Chile Co N.png" alt="Chile Comparte" />
            </a>
            <a href="https://argentinacomparte.com" class="hero-logo-item">
              <img
                src="img/LOGOS/Argentina Co N.png"
                alt="Argentina Comparte"
              />
            </a>
          </div>
          <p class="hero-desc">
            Una red que une personas, empresas y comunidades, para construir una
            región más humana, productiva y consciente.
          </p>
          <div class="hero-cta">
            <a class="btn ghost" href="#quienes">Conoce más</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section id="quienes" class="quienes-hero">
        <div class="quienes-hero-overlay"></div>
        <div class="quienes-content">
          <h1 class="quienes-title">QUIENES SOMOS</h1>
          <div class="quienes-box">
            <div class="quienes-logo">
              <img
                src="img/LOGOS/Latinoamérica Co N.png"
                alt="Latinoamérica Comparte"
              />
            </div>
            <p>
              En Latinoamérica Comparte creemos que transformar personas es
              transformar empresas.
            </p>
            <p>Nacimos de una historia real de pérdida, fe y propósito.</p>
            <p>
              Lo que comenzó en Colombia como un movimiento para ayudar a
              familias a reconstruir su productividad, hoy se ha convertido en
              una red continental que promueve el bienestar, la cultura
              organizacional y el emprendimiento con propósito.
            </p>
            <p>
              En cada país acompañamos a personas, familias y empresas a
              reencontrar su propósito productivo y a construir un futuro
              sostenible. Porque cuando un país comparte, Latinoamérica avanza.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div class="quienes-countries">
            <div class="quienes-country-logo">
              <img src="img/LOGOS/Colombia Co N.png" alt="Colombia Comparte" />
            </div>
            <div class="quienes-country-logo">
              <img src="img/LOGOS/Ecuador Co N.png" alt="Ecuador Comparte" />
            </div>
            <div class="quienes-country-logo">
              <img src="img/LOGOS/Chile Co N.png" alt="Chile Comparte" />
            </div>
            <div class="quienes-country-logo">
              <img
                src="img/LOGOS/Argentina Co N.png"
                alt="Argentina Comparte"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="contacto" class="contact-section-new">
        <div class="container">
          <div class="contact-header">
            <h2 class="contact-title-new">CONTÁCTANOS</h2>
            <p class="contact-subtitle-new">
              Pronto uno de nuestros gerentes regionales se pondrá en contacto
              contigo
            </p>
          </div>

          <div class="contact-wrapper">
            <form
              class="contact-form-new"
              id="contactFormNew"
              action="https://api.web3forms.com/submit"
              method="POST"
            >
              <!-- Web3Forms Access Key -->
              <input
                type="hidden"
                name="access_key"
                value="7a1764d4-f138-4e7a-97e2-688c2b843930"
              />
              <input
                type="hidden"
                name="subject"
                value="Nuevo mensaje desde Latinoamérica Comparte"
              />
              <input type="hidden" name="from_name" value="Formulario Web" />

              <div class="form-grid">
                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="nombre" class="form-label">Nombre *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    id="nombre"
                    name="nombre"
                    class="form-input"
                    placeholder="Tu nombre"
                    required
                  />
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="apellido" class="form-label">Apellido</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    id="apellido"
                    name="apellido"
                    class="form-input"
                    placeholder="Tu apellido"
                  />
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="telefono" class="form-label">Teléfono</label>
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    id="telefono"
                    name="telefono"
                    class="form-input"
                    placeholder="+57 300 123 4567"
                  />
                </div>

                <div class="form-group">
                  <label for="pais" class="form-label">País</label>
                  <select id="pais" name="pais" class="form-input form-select">
                    <option value="">Selecciona tu país</option>
                    <option value="Colombia">Colombia</option>
                    <option value="Ecuador">Ecuador</option>
                    <option value="Chile">Chile</option>
                    <option value="Argentina">Argentina</option>
                    <option value="Otro">Otro</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <!-- Campos de empresa (ocultos inicialmente) -->
              <div
                id="camposEmpresaNew"
                class="empresa-fields"
                style="display: none"
              >
                <div class="form-grid">
                  <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="nombreEmpresa" class="form-label"
                      >Nombre de la Empresa</label
                    >
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      id="nombreEmpresa"
                      name="nombreEmpresa"
                      class="form-input"
                      placeholder="Empresa S.A."
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="cargo" class="form-label">Cargo</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      id="cargo"
                      name="cargo"
                      class="form-input"
                      placeholder="Tu cargo en la empresa"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="form-group form-group-full">
                <label for="email" class="form-label"
                  >Correo electrónico *</label
                >
                <input
                  type="email"
                  id="email"
                  name="email"
                  class="form-input"
                  placeholder="tucorreo@ejemplo.com"
                  required
                />
              </div>

              <div class="form-group form-group-full">
                <label for="mensaje" class="form-label"
                  >¿En qué podemos ayudarte? *</label
                >
                <textarea
                  id="mensaje"
                  name="mensaje"
                  class="form-textarea"
                  rows="5"
                  placeholder="Cuéntanos cómo podemos ayudarte..."
                  required
                ></textarea>
              </div>

              <div class="form-actions">
                <button type="submit" class="btn-submit-new">
                  <span>Enviar mensaje</span>
                  <svg
                    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                    width="18"
                    height="18"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    stroke-width="2"
                    stroke-linecap="round"
                    stroke-linejoin="round"
                  >
                    <line x1="22" y1="2" x2="11" y2="13"></line>
                    <polygon points="22 2 15 22 11 13 2 9 22 2"></polygon>
                  </svg>
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

              if (window.scrollY > 100) {
                header.classList.add("scrolled");
              } else {
                header.classList.remove("scrolled");
              }
              ticking = false;

        const counters = document.querySelectorAll(".counter");
        const observerOptions = { threshold: 0.5, rootMargin: "50px" };
        const counterObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
          entries.forEach((entry) => {
            if (
              entry.isIntersecting &&
              !entry.target.classList.contains("counted")
            ) {
              entry.target.classList.add("counted");
              const target = +entry.target.dataset.target;
              let current = 0;
              const increment = target / 60;
              const timer = setInterval(() => {
                current += increment;
                if (current >= target) {
                  entry.target.textContent = target;
                  clearInterval(timer);
                } else {
                  entry.target.textContent = Math.floor(current);
                }
              }, 16);
              counterObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
          });
        }, observerOptions);
        counters.forEach((c) => counterObserver.observe(c));

        // Duplicar logos del carrusel para loop infinito
        const carouselTrack = document.querySelector(".carousel-track");
        if (carouselTrack) {

            const clone = logo.cloneNode(true);
            carouselTrack.appendChild(clone);
          });
        }

        document.querySelectorAll(".nav-links a").forEach((a) => {

              if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });

        const sections = document.querySelectorAll(".section");

          (entries) => {

              if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                entry.target.style.opacity = "1";
                entry.target.style.transform = "translateY(0)";
                sectionObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
              }
            });
          },
          { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: "50px" }
        );
        sections.forEach((s) => {
          s.style.opacity = "0";
          s.style.transform = "translateY(30px)";

Nuestros programas han impactado a más de 1,200 familias en toda la región, ayudándolas a recuperar su productividad y esperanza.</p><h4>Emprendedores que transforman</h4><p>Conoce las historias de personas que, después de enfrentar pérdidas significativas, encontraron en nuestros programas el apoyo necesario para reconstruir sus vidas y emprendimientos.           },

        // Modal mejorado con nueva estructura
        const modal = document.getElementById("newsModal");
        const modalTitle = document.getElementById("modalTitle");
        const modalImage = document.getElementById("modalImage");
        const modalDescription = document.getElementById("modalDescription");
        const modalClose = document.getElementById("modalCloseBtn");
        const modalBackdrop = document.getElementById("modalBackdrop");

        // Función para abrir modal
        function openModal(newsId) {
          const content = newsContent[newsId];
          if (content && modal) {
            modalTitle.textContent = content.title;
            modalImage.src = content.image;
            modalImage.alt = content.title;
            modalDescription.innerHTML = content.description;

            modal.classList.add("active");
            document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
          }
        }

        // Función para cerrar modal
        function closeModal() {
          modal.classList.remove("active");
          document.body.style.overflow = "";
        }

        // Event listeners para abrir modal (funciona con .read-more y .news-card-link)
        document.querySelectorAll("[data-news]").forEach((btn) => {
          btn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            const newsId = btn.getAttribute("data-news");
            openModal(newsId);
          });
        });

        // Event listeners para cerrar modal
        if (modalClose) {
          modalClose.addEventListener("click", closeModal);
        }

        if (modalBackdrop) {
          modalBackdrop.addEventListener("click", closeModal);
        }

        // Cerrar con tecla ESC
        document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
          if (e.key === "Escape" && modal.classList.contains("active")) {
            closeModal();
          }
        });
        // Funcionalidad del botón de equipo mejorada
        const verEquipoBtn = document.getElementById("verEquipoCompletoNew");
        const equipoCompleto = document.getElementById("equipoCompletoNew");
        const btnText = document.getElementById("btnTextNew");
        const btnIcon = document.getElementById("btnIconNew");
        if (verEquipoBtn && equipoCompleto) {
          verEquipoBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
            const isVisible = equipoCompleto.style.display === "block";
            if (isVisible) {
              equipoCompleto.style.opacity = "0";
              equipoCompleto.style.maxHeight = "0";
              setTimeout(() => {
                equipoCompleto.style.display = "none";
              }, 500);
              btnText.textContent = "Conoce a nuestro equipo";
              verEquipoBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
            } else {
              equipoCompleto.style.display = "block";
              setTimeout(() => {
                equipoCompleto.style.opacity = "1";
                equipoCompleto.style.maxHeight = "5000px";
              }, 50);
              btnText.textContent = "Ver menos";
              verEquipoBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
            }
          });
        }
      });

      // Manejo del envío del formulario
      const contactFormNew = document.getElementById("contactFormNew");
      const camposEmpresaNew = document.getElementById("camposEmpresaNew");

      if (contactFormNew) {
        contactFormNew.addEventListener("submit", async function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();

          const submitBtn = contactFormNew.querySelector(
            'button[type="submit"]'
          );
          const originalHTML = submitBtn.innerHTML;

          // Deshabilitar botón y mostrar estado de carga
          submitBtn.disabled = true;
          submitBtn.style.opacity = "0.7";
          submitBtn.innerHTML = "<span>Enviando mensaje...</span>";

          try {
            const formData = new FormData(contactFormNew);

            const response = await fetch(contactFormNew.action, {
              method: "POST",
              body: formData,
              headers: {
                Accept: "application/json",
              },
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (response.ok && data.success) {
              // Éxito
              alert(
                "¡Gracias por contactarnos! Tu mensaje ha sido enviado exitosamente. Pronto nos pondremos en contacto contigo."
              );
              contactFormNew.reset();
              if (camposEmpresaNew) {
                camposEmpresaNew.style.display = "none";
              }
            } else {
              // Error del servidor
              alert(
                data.message ||
                  "Hubo un problema al enviar tu mensaje. Por favor, intenta nuevamente."
              );
            }
          } catch (error) {
            // Error de conexión
            console.error("Error al enviar formulario:", error);
            alert(
              "No se pudo conectar con el servidor. Por favor, verifica tu conexión e intenta nuevamente."
            );
          } finally {
            // Restaurar botón
            submitBtn.disabled = false;
            submitBtn.style.opacity = "1";
            submitBtn.innerHTML = originalHTML;
          }
        });
      }
    </script>

        -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        background-clip: text;
        text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(155, 93, 229, 0.3);
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .brand:hover {
        transform: scale(1.05);
        filter: brightness(1.2);
      }
      .brand span {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #9b5de5 0%, #f9a826 100%);
        -webkit-background-clip: text;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        background-clip: text;
      }
      .nav-links {
        list-style: none;
        display: flex;
        gap: 5px;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        align-items: center;
      }
      .nav-links li {
        position: relative;
      }
      .nav-links a {
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
        text-decoration: none;
        font-weight: 500;
        font-size: 13px;
        padding: 10px 16px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        display: block;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        background: transparent;
      }
      .nav-links a::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        border-radius: 8px;
      }
      .nav-links a:hover {
        color: #fff;
        transform: translateY(-1px);
      }
      .nav-links a:hover::before {
        opacity: 1;
      }
      .nav-links a::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        bottom: 5px;
        left: 50%;
        transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0);
        width: 60%;
        height: 2px;
        background: #fff;
        border-radius: 2px;
        transition: transform 0.3s ease;
      }
      .nav-links a:hover::after {
        transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1);
      }
      .menu-toggle {
        display: none;
        background: rgba(155, 93, 229, 0.15);
        backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 24px;
        padding: 8px 14px;
        border-radius: 10px;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
      }
      .menu-toggle:hover {
        background: rgba(155, 93, 229, 0.3);
        transform: scale(1.05);
      }
      .btn {
        padding: 14px 32px;
        border-radius: 50px;
        text-decoration: none;
        color: #fff;
        background: transparent;
        border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 15px;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        cursor: pointer;
        display: inline-block;
        will-change: transform, box-shadow;
      }
      .btn::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background: linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
          transparent
        );
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
      }
      .btn:hover::before {
        opacity: 1;
      }
      .btn:hover {
        transform: translateY(-3px) translateZ(0);
        -webkit-transform: translateY(-3px) translateZ(0);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      }
      .btn.primary {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #790d7f 0%, #9b5de5 100%);
        box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(155, 93, 229, 0.4);
        border: 0;
      }
      .btn.primary:hover {
        box-shadow: 0 15px 50px rgba(155, 93, 229, 0.6);
        transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.03) translateZ(0);
        -webkit-transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.03) translateZ(0);
      }
      .btn.ghost {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
        backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        padding: 16px 40px;
        font-size: 15px;
      }
      .btn.ghost:hover {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
        border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
      }
      .btn-outline-white {
        display: inline-block;
        padding: 16px 40px;
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #790d7f !important;
        background: #fff;
        border: 2px solid #fff;
        border-radius: 50px;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        letter-spacing: 1px;
      }
      .btn-outline-white:hover {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        color: #ffffff !important;
        border-color: #ffffff;
        transform: translateY(-3px);
        box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
      }
      .btn-solid-white {
        display: inline-block;
        padding: 16px 40px;
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #790d7f !important;
        background: #fff;
        border: 2px solid #fff;
        border-radius: 50px;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        letter-spacing: 1px;
      }
      .btn-solid-white:hover {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        color: #ffffff !important;
        border-color: #ffffff;
        transform: translateY(-3px);
        box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
      }
      .hero {

        padding-top: 120px;

      }
      .hero::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background-image: url("../img/FOTOS/foto mentores dic 2024.jpeg");
        background-size: cover;
        background-position: center;
        filter: brightness(0.4) saturate(1.2);
        opacity: 1;
      }
      .hero-overlay {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background: linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          rgba(121, 13, 127, 0.75) 0%,

          rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.75) 100%

      .hero-logos {

      .section {
        padding: 100px 0;
      }
      .section-title {
        font-size: 48px;
        margin: 0 0 30px;
        color: #fff;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-align: center;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      }
      .lead {
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 19px;
        margin-bottom: 50px;
        opacity: 0.9;
        line-height: 1.6;
        max-width: 800px;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
      }
      .subtle {
        text-align: center;
        margin-top: 80px;
        margin-bottom: 15px;
        font-size: 22px;
        font-weight: 600;
        opacity: 0.95;
      }

      .section.impact {
        background: linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #790d7f 0%,
          #9b5de5 50%,
          #667eea 100%
        );
        position: relative;
      }
      .section.impact .container {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
      }
      .impact-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
        gap: 35px;
        margin-top: 60px;
      }
      .impact-item {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        padding: 50px 30px;
        border-radius: 16px;
        text-align: center;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .impact-item::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: -100%;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        background: transparent;
        transition: left 0.6s ease;
      }
      .impact-item:hover::before {
        left: 100%;
      }
      .impact-item:hover {
        transform: translateY(-8px);
        -webkit-transform: translateY(-8px);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
        border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
      }
      .impact-icon {
        width: 70px;
        height: 70px;
        margin: 0 auto 25px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
        border-radius: 14px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        box-shadow: none;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        will-change: transform;
      }
      .impact-item:hover .impact-icon {
        transform: scale(1.05);
        -webkit-transform: scale(1.05);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      }
      .impact-icon svg {
        width: 40px;
        height: 40px;
        color: #fff;
      }
      .impact-number {
        margin: 20px 0 15px;
      }
      .counter {
        display: block;
        font-size: 54px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #fff;
        text-shadow: none;
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .impact-text {
        font-size: 16px;
        font-weight: 500;
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
        line-height: 1.5;
        margin-top: 15px;
      }
      .carousel {
        margin-top: 60px;
        overflow: hidden;
        padding: 30px 0;
      }
      .carousel-desc {
        text-align: center;
        max-width: 800px;
        margin: 0 auto 40px;
        opacity: 0.95;
        font-size: 17px;
        line-height: 1.6;
      }
      .carousel-track {
        display: flex;
        gap: 24px;
        align-items: center;
        animation: slide 40s linear infinite;
        -webkit-animation: slide 40s linear infinite;
        width: fit-content;
        will-change: transform;
      }
      .logo-item {
        min-width: 200px;
        height: 130px;
        background: #ffffff;
        border: 1px solid #e8e8e8;
        border-radius: 16px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        padding: 25px;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
      }
      .logo-item:hover {
        transform: translateY(-3px);
        box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(121, 13, 127, 0.1);
        border-color: #790d7f;
      }
      .logo-item img {
        max-width: 100%;
        max-height: 100%;
        object-fit: contain;
      }

      @keyframes slide {
        0% {
          transform: translateX(0);
        }
        100% {
          transform: translateX(-50%);
        }
      }
      .country-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
        gap: 24px;
        justify-content: center;
        margin-top: 18px;
        max-width: 900px;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
      }
      .country {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
        padding: 20px;
        border-radius: 16px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        color: #fff;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      }
      .country:hover {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
        transform: translateY(-5px);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
      }
      .country img {
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
        object-fit: contain;
        filter: brightness(1.1);
      }
      .country span {
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 16px;
      }
      .section.team {
        background: #ffffff;

      }
      .section.team .container {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 2;
      }

      .section.team .section-title {
        color: #790d7f;

      .section.news .section-title {

      .section.contact .section-title {

      @media (max-width: 900px) {
        .lead {
          font-size: 17px;

        }

      .team-cta {
        text-align: center;
        margin-top: 50px;
      }
      .team-cta button {
        cursor: pointer;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
      }
      .team-full-section {
        margin-top: 50px;
        background: #f8f9fa;
        border: 1px solid #e8e8e8;
        border-radius: 24px;
        padding: 50px 30px;
        animation: slideDown 0.5s ease-out;
      }
      @keyframes slideDown {
        from {
          opacity: 0;
          max-height: 0;
        }
        to {
          opacity: 1;
          max-height: 5000px;
        }
      }
      .team-full-container {
        max-height: 800px;
        overflow-y: auto;
        padding-right: 10px;
      }
      .team-full-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 10px;
      }
      .team-full-container::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        border-radius: 10px;
      }
      .team-full-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #9b5de5 100%);
        border-radius: 10px;
      }
      .team-full-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #9b5de5 0%, #e94560 100%);
      }
      .team-full-title {
        font-size: 32px;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 40px;
        color: #790d7f;
        text-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      }
      .team-full-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr));
        gap: 40px;
        padding: 0 20px 20px;
      }
      .team-member {
        text-align: center;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        opacity: 0;
        animation: fadeInUp 0.6s ease forwards;
      }
      .team-member:hover {
        transform: translateY(-10px);
      }
      .member-photo {
        width: 180px;
        height: 180px;
        margin: 0 auto 20px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        overflow: hidden;
        box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
        border: 3px solid #790d7f;
        background: linear-gradient(white, white) padding-box,
          linear-gradient(135deg, #790d7f 0%, #9b5de5 100%) border-box;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
      }
      .team-member:hover .member-photo {
        box-shadow: 0 15px 50px rgba(155, 93, 229, 0.4);
        transform: scale(1.05);
      }
      .member-photo img {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        object-fit: cover;
        display: block;
      }
      .member-name {
        font-size: 22px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #000;
        margin: 15px 0 5px;
        background: #fff;
        -webkit-background-clip: text;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        background-clip: text;
      }
      .member-role {
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #000;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
      }
      @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .impact-grid {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
          gap: 20px;
        }
        .impact-icon {
          width: 60px;
          height: 60px;
        }
        .impact-icon svg {
          width: 30px;
          height: 30px;
        }
        .counter {
          font-size: 36px;
        }
        .impact-text {
          font-size: 14px;
        }
        .team-full-container {
          max-height: 600px;
        }
        .team-full-grid {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
          gap: 30px;
          padding: 20px 10px 20px;
        }
        .member-photo {
          width: 150px;
          height: 150px;
        }
        .member-name {
          font-size: 18px;
        }
        .team-full-title {
          font-size: 24px;
        }
        .impact-icon {
          will-change: auto;
        }
        .impact-item:hover .impact-icon {
          transform: none;
        }
        .site-header {
          background: #790d7f;
        }
        * {
          will-change: auto !important;
          animation-duration: 0.2s !important;
          transition-duration: 0.15s !important;
        }
        .carousel-track {
          will-change: transform;
          animation-duration: 15s !important;
        }
        body::before {
          display: none;
        }
        .section.news {
          background-image: linear-gradient(
            135deg,
            rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.95) 0%,
            rgba(155, 93, 229, 0.95) 50%,
            rgba(233, 69, 96, 0.95) 100%
          );
        }
      }
      @media (max-width: 480px) {
        .impact-grid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
          gap: 15px;
        }
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        *:not(.carousel-track),
        *:not(.carousel-track)::before,
        *:not(.carousel-track)::after {
          animation-duration: 0.5s !important;
          transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
        }
        .carousel-track {
          animation-duration: 60s !important;
        }
      }
      .section {
        backface-visibility: hidden;
        -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
      }
      .section.news {
        background: #ffffff;
        position: relative;
        padding: 120px 0;
      }
      .section.news .container {
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;

      .news-grid {

      .news-item {

        height: auto;
      }
      .footer-links ul {

      .footer-links a {
        color: #fff;
        text-decoration: none;
        opacity: 0.9;

      }
      .footer-links a:hover {

      .social-icons-grid {

      .social-icon {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
        border-radius: 12px;
        transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        background: transparent;
        box-shadow: none;
      }
      .social-icon::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
        z-index: 0;
      }
      .social-icon:hover::before {
        opacity: 1;
      }
      .social-icon svg {
        width: 28px;
        height: 28px;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
        color: #ffffff;
        fill: #ffffff;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
      }
      .social-icon:hover {
        transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.1);
        box-shadow: none;
      }
      .social-icon:hover svg {
        transform: scale(1.1);
      }
      .social-icon.instagram {
        background: transparent;
      }
      .social-icon.facebook {
        background: transparent;
      }
      .social-icon.youtube {
        background: transparent;
      }
      .social-icon.tiktok {

      .country-logos {

      .country-logos a:hover {

      }
      .country-logos img {

      @media (max-width: 900px) {

        }

        }

      .modal {
        display: none;
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 1000;
        left: 0;
        top: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        overflow: auto;
        background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
        backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
        padding: 20px;
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
      }
      .modal[style*="display: flex"] {
        opacity: 1;
      }
      @keyframes slideDown {
        from {
          transform: translateY(-50px) scale(0.95);
          opacity: 0;
        }
        to {
          transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
          opacity: 1;
        }
      }
      .modal-content {
        position: relative;
        background: linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98) 0%,
          rgba(248, 250, 255, 0.98) 100%
        );
        margin: 3% auto;
        padding: 0;
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 950px;
        border-radius: 30px;
        box-shadow: 0 25px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
        animation: slideDown 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
        overflow: hidden;
        border: none;
      }
      .modal-close {
        position: absolute;
        top: 25px;
        right: 25px;
        background: linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98) 0%,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) 100%
        );
        border: 2px solid rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.2);
        font-size: 32px;
        font-weight: 300;
        color: #667eea;
        cursor: pointer;
        z-index: 10;
        width: 55px;
        height: 55px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
        box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
        line-height: 1;
      }
      .modal-close:hover {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #790d7f 0%, #9b5de5 100%);
        color: white;
        transform: rotate(90deg) scale(1.15);
        box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(121, 13, 127, 0.6);
        border-color: transparent;
      }
      .modal-body {
        padding: 0;
        max-height: 85vh;
        overflow-y: auto;
      }
      .modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 8px;
      }
      .modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
        border-radius: 10px;
      }
      .modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
        border-radius: 10px;
      }
      .modal-image {
        width: 100%;
        height: 450px;
        object-fit: cover;
        display: block;
        border-radius: 30px 30px 0 0;
      }
      .modal-title {
        font-size: 44px;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: #333;
        margin: 45px 55px 25px;
        line-height: 1.2;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
        -webkit-background-clip: text;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        background-clip: text;
        letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      }
      .modal-description {
        padding: 0 55px 55px;
        font-size: 18px;
        line-height: 1.9;
        color: #444;
      }
      .modal-description h4 {
        font-size: 26px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #333;
        margin-top: 35px;
        margin-bottom: 18px;
        position: relative;
        padding-left: 20px;
      }
      .modal-description h4::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        width: 5px;
        height: 28px;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
        border-radius: 3px;
      }
      .modal-description p {
        margin-bottom: 20px;
        text-align: justify;
      }
      .modal-description ul {
        margin: 20px 0;
        padding-left: 30px;
      }
      .modal-description li {
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        line-height: 1.8;
        position: relative;
        padding-left: 10px;
      }
      .modal-description li::marker {
        color: #667eea;
        font-weight: 600;
      }
      .campos-empresa {
        animation: slideInDown 0.4s ease-out;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      @keyframes slideInDown {
        from {
          max-height: 0;
          opacity: 0;
        }
        to {
          max-height: 500px;
          opacity: 1;
        }
      }
      @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .modal-content {
          width: 95%;
          margin: 10% auto;
        }
        .modal-image {
          height: 250px;
        }
        .modal-title {
          font-size: 28px;
          margin: 30px 25px 15px;
        }
        .modal-description {
          padding: 0 25px 30px;
          font-size: 16px;
        }
        .modal-close {
          width: 40px;
          height: 40px;
          font-size: 28px;
          top: 15px;
          right: 15px;
        }
        .section {
          padding: 80px 0;
        }
        .section-title {
          font-size: 36px;
        }
        .lead {
          font-size: 16px;
        }
      }

      @keyframes fadeInUp {
        from {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translateY(20px);
        }
        to {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: translateY(0);
        }
      }

      .section > .container > * {
        animation: fadeInUp 0.6s ease-out backwards;
      }

      a:focus-visible,
      button:focus-visible,
      input:focus-visible,
      textarea:focus-visible,
      select:focus-visible {
        outline: 3px solid #790d7f;
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }

      .apoyar-section-new {
        padding: 120px 0;

        );

        overflow: hidden;

      .apoyar-section-new::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: -50%;
        right: -20%;
        width: 600px;
        height: 600px;
        background: radial-gradient(
          circle,
          rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 0%,
          transparent 70%
        );
        border-radius: 50%;

      .apoyar-header {

      .apoyar-grid-new {

      .apoyar-card {
        background: #ffffff;

        }

        .contact-title-new {
          font-size: 36px;
        }

        .contact-subtitle-new {
          font-size: 16px;
        }

        .contact-form-new {
          padding: 35px 25px;
        }

        .form-grid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
          gap: 20px;
        }

        .btn-submit-new {
          width: 100%;
          justify-content: center;
        }
      }

      /* ========================================
         ESTILOS PARA SECCIÓN EQUIPO MEJORADA
         ======================================== */
      .section.team-new {
        background: #ffffff;
        padding: 120px 0;
        position: relative;
      }

      .team-header-new {
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 60px;
      }

      .section-title-new {
        font-size: 52px;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: #790d7f;
        margin: 0 0 20px;
        letter-spacing: 2px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .section-lead-new {
        font-size: 18px;
        color: #555555;
        margin: 0 auto;
        max-width: 700px;
        line-height: 1.7;
      }

      .team-cta-new {
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 50px;
      }

      .btn-team-toggle {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 10px;
        padding: 16px 40px;
        background: #790d7f;
        color: #ffffff;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 12px;
        font-size: 16px;
        font-weight: 600;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        font-family: "Poppins", sans-serif;
      }

      .btn-team-toggle:hover {
        background: #9b5de5;
        transform: translateY(-3px);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(121, 13, 127, 0.3);
      }

      .btn-team-icon {
        transition: transform 0.3s ease;
      }

      .btn-team-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .btn-team-icon {
        transform: rotate(180deg);
      }

      .team-grid-section {
        overflow: hidden;
        transition: all 0.5s ease;
      }

      .team-grid-container {
        max-height: 700px;
        overflow-y: auto;
        padding: 20px 10px;
      }

      .team-grid-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 8px;
      }

      .team-grid-container::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
        background: #f0f0f0;
        border-radius: 10px;
      }

      .team-grid-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #790d7f 0%, #9b5de5 100%);
        border-radius: 10px;
      }

      .team-grid-new {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
        gap: 35px;
      }

      .team-card-new {
        background: #ffffff;
        border-radius: 16px;
        overflow: hidden;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        border: 1px solid #e8e8e8;
      }

      .team-card-new:hover {
        transform: translateY(-8px);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(121, 13, 127, 0.15);
        border-color: #790d7f;
      }

      .team-card-image {
        width: 100%;
        height: 280px;
        overflow: hidden;
        position: relative;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0e6f6 0%, #e8dff5 100%);
      }

      .team-card-image::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background: linear-gradient(
          180deg,
          transparent 0%,
          rgba(121, 13, 127, 0.1) 100%
        );
      }

      .team-card-image img {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        object-fit: cover;
        transition: transform 0.3s ease;
      }

      .team-card-new:hover .team-card-image img {
        transform: scale(1.05);
      }

      .team-card-content {
        padding: 25px;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .team-card-name {
        font-size: 20px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #222222;
        margin: 0 0 10px;
        line-height: 1.3;
      }

      .team-card-role {
        font-size: 14px;
        color: #666666;
        margin: 0;
        line-height: 1.5;
        font-weight: 500;
      }

      /* ========================================
         ESTILOS PARA SECCIÓN NOTICIAS MEJORADA
         ======================================== */
      .section.news-new {
        background: #f8f9fa;
        padding: 120px 0;
        position: relative;
      }

      .news-header-new {
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 60px;
      }

      .news-grid-new {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(340px, 1fr));
        gap: 40px;
        max-width: 1200px;
        margin: 0 auto;
      }

      .news-card-new {
        background: #ffffff;
        border-radius: 16px;
        overflow: hidden;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        border: 1px solid #e8e8e8;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
      }

      .news-card-new:hover {
        transform: translateY(-8px);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(121, 13, 127, 0.15);
        border-color: #790d7f;
      }

      .news-card-image {
        width: 100%;
        height: 240px;
        overflow: hidden;
        position: relative;
      }

      .news-card-image img {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        object-fit: cover;
        transition: transform 0.3s ease;
      }

      .news-card-new:hover .news-card-image img {
        transform: scale(1.1);
      }

      .news-card-overlay {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        background: linear-gradient(
          180deg,
          transparent 0%,
          rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) 100%
        );
        display: flex;
        align-items: flex-end;
        padding: 20px;
      }

      .news-card-category {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
        color: #790d7f;
        padding: 6px 14px;
        border-radius: 20px;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      }

      .news-card-content {
        padding: 30px;
        flex: 1;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
      }

      .news-card-title {
        font-size: 22px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #222222;
        margin: 0 0 15px;
        line-height: 1.3;
      }

      .news-card-description {
        font-size: 15px;
        color: #666666;
        line-height: 1.6;
        margin: 0 0 25px;
        flex: 1;
      }

      .news-card-link {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        color: #790d7f;
        text-decoration: none;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 15px;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
      }

      .news-card-link:hover {
        gap: 12px;
        color: #9b5de5;
      }

      .news-card-link svg {
        transition: transform 0.3s ease;
      }

      .news-card-link:hover svg {
        transform: translateX(4px);
      }

      /* ========================================
         ESTILOS PARA MODAL MEJORADO
         ======================================== */
      .modal-new {
        display: none;
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 1000;
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
      }

      .modal-new.active {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        padding: 20px;
        opacity: 1;
      }

      .modal-backdrop {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
        backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      }

      .modal-container-new {
        position: relative;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 900px;
        max-height: 90vh;
        background: #ffffff;
        border-radius: 24px;
        overflow: hidden;
        box-shadow: 0 25px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
        animation: modalSlideIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
        z-index: 1001;
      }

      @keyframes modalSlideIn {
        from {
          transform: scale(0.9) translateY(30px);
          opacity: 0;
        }
        to {
          transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
          opacity: 1;
        }
      }

      .modal-close-new {
        position: absolute;
        top: 20px;
        right: 20px;
        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
        border: none;
        border-radius: 50%;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        z-index: 10;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
      }

      .modal-close-new:hover {
        background: #790d7f;
        transform: rotate(90deg) scale(1.1);
        box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(121, 13, 127, 0.4);
      }

      .modal-close-new svg {
        color: #790d7f;
        transition: color 0.3s ease;
      }

      .modal-close-new:hover svg {
        color: #ffffff;
      }

      .modal-content-new {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        max-height: 90vh;
        overflow-y: auto;
      }

      .modal-content-new::-webkit-scrollbar {
        width: 8px;
      }

      .modal-content-new::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
        background: #f0f0f0;
      }

      .modal-content-new::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #790d7f 0%, #9b5de5 100%);
        border-radius: 10px;
      }

      .modal-image-wrapper {
        width: 100%;
        height: 400px;
        overflow: hidden;
        position: relative;
        background: #f0f0f0;
      }

      .modal-image-new {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        object-fit: cover;
      }

      .modal-body-new {
        padding: 45px 50px 50px;
      }

      .modal-title-new {
        font-size: 38px;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: #222222;
        margin: 0 0 25px;
        line-height: 1.2;
        letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      }

      .modal-description-new {
        font-size: 17px;
        line-height: 1.8;
        color: #444444;
      }

      .modal-description-new h4 {
        font-size: 24px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #790d7f;
        margin: 35px 0 18px;
        position: relative;
        padding-left: 20px;
      }

      .modal-description-new h4::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        width: 5px;
        height: 28px;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #790d7f 0%, #9b5de5 100%);
        border-radius: 3px;
      }

      .modal-description-new p {
        margin-bottom: 20px;
        text-align: justify;
      }

      .modal-description-new ul {
        margin: 20px 0;
        padding-left: 30px;
      }

      .modal-description-new li {
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        line-height: 1.8;
      }

      .modal-description-new li::marker {
        color: #790d7f;
        font-weight: 600;
      }

      /* ========================================
         MEDIA QUERIES PARA RESPONSIVE
         ======================================== */
      @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .section.team-new {
          padding: 80px 0;
        }

        .section-title-new {
          font-size: 36px;
        }

        .section-lead-new {
          font-size: 16px;
        }

        .team-grid-new {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr));
          gap: 25px;
        }

        .team-card-image {
          height: 240px;
        }

        .team-grid-container {
          max-height: 600px;
        }

        .section.news-new {
          padding: 80px 0;
        }

        .news-grid-new {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
          gap: 30px;
        }

        .modal-container-new {
          margin: 20px;
          max-height: 85vh;
        }

        .modal-image-wrapper {
          height: 250px;
        }

        .modal-close-new {
          width: 40px;
          height: 40px;
          top: 15px;
          right: 15px;
        }

        .modal-body-new {
          padding: 30px 25px 35px;
        }

        .modal-title-new {
          font-size: 28px;
        }

        .modal-description-new {
          font-size: 16px;
        }

        .modal-description-new h4 {
          font-size: 20px;
        }
      }
    </style>
    <script
      src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/animejs/3.2.1/anime.min.js"
      defer
    ></script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <header class="site-header">
      <nav class="navbar">

        <ul class="nav-links">

    <main>
      <section id="hero" class="hero">
        <div class="hero-overlay"></div>
        <div class="hero-content container">
          <h1 class="hero-title">UN PROPÓSITO QUE NACIÓ DE COLOMBIA</h1>
          <h2 class="hero-subtitle">HOY INSPIRA A TODA LATINOAMÉRICA</h2>
          <div class="hero-logos">
            <a href="https://colombiacomparte.com" class="hero-logo-item">
              <img src="img/LOGOS/Colombia Co N.png" alt="Colombia Comparte" />
            </a>
            <a href="https://ecuadorcomparte.com.co" class="hero-logo-item">
              <img src="img/LOGOS/Ecuador Co N.png" alt="Ecuador Comparte" />
            </a>
            <a href="#hero" class="hero-logo-item hero-logo-main">
              <img
                src="img/LOGOS/Latinoamérica Co N.png"
                alt="Latinoamérica Comparte"
              />
            </a>
            <a href="https://chilecomparte.com.co" class="hero-logo-item">
              <img src="img/LOGOS/Chile Co N.png" alt="Chile Comparte" />
            </a>
            <a href="https://argentinacomparte.com" class="hero-logo-item">
              <img
                src="img/LOGOS/Argentina Co N.png"
                alt="Argentina Comparte"
              />
            </a>
          </div>
          <p class="hero-desc">
            Una red que une personas, empresas y comunidades, para construir una
            región más humana, productiva y consciente.
          </p>
          <div class="hero-cta">
            <a class="btn ghost" href="#quienes">Conoce más</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section id="quienes" class="quienes-hero">
        <div class="quienes-hero-overlay"></div>
        <div class="quienes-content">
          <h1 class="quienes-title">QUIENES SOMOS</h1>
          <div class="quienes-box">
            <div class="quienes-logo">
              <img
                src="img/LOGOS/Latinoamérica Co N.png"
                alt="Latinoamérica Comparte"
              />
            </div>
            <p>
              En Latinoamérica Comparte creemos que transformar personas es
              transformar empresas.
            </p>
            <p>Nacimos de una historia real de pérdida, fe y propósito.</p>
            <p>
              Lo que comenzó en Colombia como un movimiento para ayudar a
              familias a reconstruir su productividad, hoy se ha convertido en
              una red continental que promueve el bienestar, la cultura
              organizacional y el emprendimiento con propósito.
            </p>
            <p>
              En cada país acompañamos a personas, familias y empresas a
              reencontrar su propósito productivo y a construir un futuro
              sostenible. Porque cuando un país comparte, Latinoamérica avanza.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div class="quienes-countries">
            <div class="quienes-country-logo">
              <img src="img/LOGOS/Colombia Co N.png" alt="Colombia Comparte" />
            </div>
            <div class="quienes-country-logo">
              <img src="img/LOGOS/Ecuador Co N.png" alt="Ecuador Comparte" />
            </div>
            <div class="quienes-country-logo">
              <img src="img/LOGOS/Chile Co N.png" alt="Chile Comparte" />
            </div>
            <div class="quienes-country-logo">
              <img
                src="img/LOGOS/Argentina Co N.png"
                alt="Argentina Comparte"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section id="impacto" class="section impact">
        <div class="container">
          <h3 class="section-title">NUESTRO IMPACTO</h3>
          <div class="impact-grid">
            <div class="impact-item">
              <div class="impact-icon">
                <svg
                  xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"

                >
                  <path
                    d="M12 2C6.48 2 2 6.48 2 12s4.48 10 10 10 10-4.48 10-10S17.52 2 12 2zm-2 15l-5-5 1.41-1.41L10 14.17l7.59-7.59L19 8l-9 9z"
                  />
                </svg>
              </div>
              <div class="impact-number">

              </div>
              <div class="impact-text">

                <svg

                  <path

                  />

              </div>
              <div class="impact-text">familias transformadas</div>

            <div class="impact-item">

              <div class="impact-text">emprendimientos creados</div>

            <div class="impact-item">
              <div class="impact-icon">

              </div>
              <div class="impact-text">empresas aliadas</div>

              <div class="logo-item">
                <img src="img/LOGOS/KANTAR IBOPE.png" alt="KANTAR IBOPE" />

              <div class="logo-item">
                <img

                />
              </div>
              <div class="logo-item">
                <img
                  src="img/LOGOS/Logo_Homecenter_Sodimac.png"

                />
              </div>
              <div class="logo-item">
                <img src="img/LOGOS/logo-jm-tracking-1.png" alt="JM Tracking" />
